changes.title: Claim 19: retain stretch plus one
changes.original: Claim 19 gives weighted girth > (1+sε)2k after greedy stretch (1+sε)(2k−1).
changes.changed: Use weighted girth > t+1 = 2k+sε(2k−1). Choose s ≥ 4g in the downstream Claim 23 comparison.
changes.why: The displayed stronger threshold differs by sε and fails on triangles. The corrected graph-level cycle contradiction is checked.

changes.title: Lower-bound minor parameter starts at three
changes.original: Theorem 13’s proof says the lower bound holds for every positive h and uses trees for bounded h.
changes.changed: The verified lower family requires h ≥ 3.
changes.why: A K₂-minor-free graph is edgeless, whereas every nontrivial tree contains a K₂ minor. The large-h asymptotic lower bound is unaffected.
texts: Lower-bound domain: h must be at least 3

changes.title: Individual lightness need not exceed sparsity
changes.original: Section 1.1 asserts lightness dominates sparsity for an individual weighted graph.
changes.changed: Remove or qualify that comparison; the main upper-bound argument here does not depend on it.
changes.why: A unit K₄ plus a weight-10 bridge has lightness 16/13 below sparsity 7/5. This is source-checked commentary, not an additional Lean-certified graph theorem.
texts: Lightness need not dominate sparsity for an individual weighted graph

changes.title: Postle dependency: proof-budget repairs
changes.original: The cited proof uses 1+Kd+ceil(ε₁d) ≤ 3Kd and later stronger or mis-scaled intermediate budgets.
changes.changed: Omit the unnecessary vertex v; use the source-checked k⁶ density denominators and the needed d₀ ≥ ℓ² inequality.
changes.why: The +1 estimate fails for some real d near 1. The graph repair preserves the proposition’s parameter domain; the later display corrections are separately source-checked, not main-theorem counterexamples.
